WHITESPACE = " \n" PUNCTUATION = %q(!"#$%&'()*+,-./:;<=>?@[\]^_`{|}~) TOC_MARKER = "\0toc\0" Block = Struct.new(:kind, :text, :number, :children, :items, :alignments, :rows, :lines, :ordered, keyword_init: true) Delimiter = Data.define(:char, :length, :can_open, :can_close) TocEntry = Struct.new(:level, :id, :label, :children) def escape_html(text) text.gsub(/[&<>"]/, '&' => '&', '<' => '<', '>' => '>', '"' => '"') end def strip_tags(text) = text.gsub(/<[^>]*>/, '') def normalize(text) = text.downcase.gsub(/[ \n]+/, ' ').strip def skip_space(text, at) at += 1 while at < text.size && WHITESPACE.include?(text[at]) at end def escaped_read(text, at, stops) result = +'' while at < text.size && !stops.include?(text[at]) at += 1 if text[at] == '\\' && at + 1 < text.size && PUNCTUATION.include?(text[at + 1]) result << text[at] at += 1 end [result, at] end def opening_fence(line) match = /\A(`{3,}|~{3,})/.match(line) return nil unless match fence = match[0] info = line[fence.size..].strip return nil if fence[0] == '`' && info.include?('`') [fence, info] end def atx_heading(line) match = /\A(\#{1,6})(?: |\z)/.match(line) return nil unless match text = line[match[1].size..].strip trimmed = text.sub(/\#+\z/, '') text = trimmed.strip if trimmed.empty? || trimmed.end_with?(' ') Block.new(kind: :heading, text: text, number: match[1].size) end def rule?(line) = /\A(?:-{3,}|\*{3,}|_{3,})\z/.match?(line.delete(' ')) def list_marker(line) return nil if rule?(line) match = /\A(?:([-*+])|([0-9]{1,9})([.)])) +/.match(line) return nil unless match [match[1] || match[3], !match[2].nil?, match[2]&.to_i, line[match[0].size..]] end def interrupts?(line) !line.start_with?(' ') && (opening_fence(line) || atx_heading(line) || rule?(line) || line.start_with?('>') || list_marker(line)) end def split_cells(line) text = line.strip.delete_prefix('|') cells = [+''] at = 0 separator = false while at < text.size char = text[at] at += 1 separator = false if char == '\\' && at < text.size cells[-1] << '\\' unless text[at] == '|' cells[-1] << text[at] at += 1 elsif char == '|' cells << +'' separator = true else cells[-1] << char end end cells.pop if separator cells.map(&:strip) end class BlockParser attr_reader :references, :footnotes def initialize @references = {} @footnotes = {} end def parse(lines) blocks = [] at = 0 while at < lines.size line = lines[at] if line.empty? at += 1 next end if line.start_with?(' ') finish = at finish += 1 while finish < lines.size && (lines[finish].empty? || lines[finish].start_with?(' ')) finish -= 1 while lines[finish - 1].empty? blocks << Block.new(kind: :code, text: '', lines: lines[at...finish].map { |row| row[4..] || '' }) at = finish next end unless line.start_with?(' ') if (fence = opening_fence(line)) marker, info = fence code = [] at += 1 while at < lines.size row = lines[at] at += 1 break if row.size >= marker.size && row.delete(marker[0]).empty? code << row end blocks << Block.new(kind: :code, text: info.split(' ').first || '', lines: code) next end if (heading = atx_heading(line)) blocks << heading at += 1 next end if rule?(line) blocks << Block.new(kind: :rule) at += 1 next end if line.start_with?('>') content = [] while at < lines.size && lines[at].start_with?('>') content << lines[at][1..].delete_prefix(' ') at += 1 end alert = /\A\[!(NOTE|TIP|IMPORTANT|WARNING|CAUTION)\]\z/.match(content.first) content.shift if alert blocks << Block.new(kind: alert ? :alert : :quote, text: alert&.[](1), children: parse(content)) next end if (marker = list_marker(line)) kind, ordered, number, = marker items = [] loop do content = [marker[3]] at += 1 while at < lines.size && lines[at].start_with?(' ') content << lines[at][2..] at += 1 end items << parse(content) following = at following += 1 while following < lines.size && lines[following].empty? marker = following < lines.size ? list_marker(lines[following]) : nil break unless marker && marker[0] == kind && marker[1] == ordered at = following end blocks << Block.new(kind: :list, ordered: ordered, number: number, items: items) next end if definition?(line) at += 1 next end if at + 1 < lines.size && line.include?('|') && lines[at + 1].include?('|') header = split_cells(line) delimiters = split_cells(lines[at + 1]) if header.size == delimiters.size && delimiters.all? { |cell| /\A:?-+:?\z/.match?(cell) } alignments = delimiters.map do |cell| cell.start_with?(':') ? (cell.end_with?(':') ? 'center' : 'left') : (cell.end_with?(':') ? 'right' : nil) end rows = [] at += 2 while at < lines.size && lines[at].include?('|') row = split_cells(lines[at]).take(header.size) rows << row + Array.new(header.size - row.size, '') at += 1 end blocks << Block.new(kind: :table, alignments: alignments, lines: header, rows: rows) next end end end text = [line.lstrip] at += 1 level = nil while at < lines.size && !lines[at].empty? if /\A(?:={3,}|-{3,})\z/.match?(lines[at]) level = lines[at][0] == '=' ? 1 : 2 at += 1 break end break if interrupts?(lines[at]) text << lines[at].lstrip at += 1 end text = text.join("\n") blocks << Block.new(kind: level ? :heading : (text == '[TOC]' ? :toc : :paragraph), text: text, number: level) end blocks end def definition?(line) if (match = /\A\[\^([A-Za-z0-9_-]+)\]:(.*)\z/.match(line)) && !match[2].strip.empty? @footnotes[match[1].downcase] ||= match[2].strip return true end return false unless line.start_with?('[') close = line.index(']') return false unless close && line[close + 1] == ':' label = line[1...close] return false if label.include?('[') || label.strip.empty? || label.start_with?('^') url, finish = escaped_read(line, skip_space(line, close + 2), ' ') return false if url.empty? at = skip_space(line, finish) title = nil if at < line.size return false if at == finish || !"\"'".include?(line[at]) title, finish = escaped_read(line, at + 1, line[at]) return false unless finish == line.size - 1 end @references[normalize(label)] ||= [url, title] true end end def run_end(text, at) char = text[at] at += 1 at += 1 while at < text.size && text[at] == char at end def backtick_closer(text, at, length) while (at = text.index('`', at)) finish = run_end(text, at) return at if finish - at == length at = finish end nil end def closing_bracket(text, at) depth = 0 while at < text.size char = text[at] if char == '\\' at += 2 next end if char == '`' finish = run_end(text, at) close = backtick_closer(text, finish, finish - at) at = close ? close + finish - at : finish next end depth += 1 if char == '[' if char == ']' depth -= 1 return at if depth.zero? end at += 1 end nil end def emphasis(pieces, first = 0, finish = pieces.size) html = +'' at = first while at < finish piece = pieces[at] if piece.is_a?(String) html << piece else close = piece.can_open && ((at + 1)...finish).find do |index| other = pieces[index] other.is_a?(Delimiter) && other.char == piece.char && other.length == piece.length && other.can_close end if close opening, closing = piece.char == '~' ? ['', ''] : { 1 => ['', ''], 2 => ['', ''], 3 => ['', ''] }.fetch(piece.length) html << opening << emphasis(pieces, at + 1, close) << closing at = close else html << piece.char * piece.length end end at += 1 end html end class Renderer def initialize(references, footnotes) @references, @footnotes = references, footnotes @used_ids = {} @headings = [] @note_numbers = {} @note_counts = Hash.new(0) end def inline(text, links: true, notes: true) pieces = [] at = 0 while at < text.size char = text[at] following = text[at + 1] if char == '\\' if following && PUNCTUATION.include?(following) pieces << escape_html(following) at += 2 elsif following == "\n" pieces << "
\n" at += 2 else pieces << '\\' at += 1 end next end if char == '`' finish = run_end(text, at) close = backtick_closer(text, finish, finish - at) if close code = text[finish...close].tr("\n", ' ') code = code[1...-1] if code.start_with?(' ') && code.end_with?(' ') && !code.strip.empty? pieces << "#{escape_html(code)}" at = close + finish - at else pieces << text[at...finish] at = finish end next end if links && char == '<' && (close = text.index('>', at + 1)) target = text[(at + 1)...close] href = nil if !target.match?(/[ \n<]/) && /\Ahttps?:\/\/.+/m.match?(target) href = target elsif /\A[A-Za-z0-9.+_-]+@[A-Za-z0-9-]+(?:\.[A-Za-z0-9-]+)+\z/.match?(target) href = "mailto:#{target}" end if href pieces << %(#{escape_html(target)}) at = close + 1 next end end if links && (at.zero? || " \n*_~(".include?(text[at - 1])) && (match = /\Ahttps?:\/\/[^ \n<]*/.match(text[at..])) url = match[0].sub(/[.,:;!?*_~)]+\z/, '') unless %w[http:// https://].include?(url) pieces << %(#{escape_html(url)}) at += url.size next end end if char == '[' || (char == '!' && following == '[') if links && notes && text[at, 2] == '[^' && (close = text.index(']', at + 2)) name = text[(at + 2)...close].downcase if @footnotes.key?(name) pieces << footnote_reference(name) at = close + 1 next end end image = char == '!' opening = at + (image ? 1 : 0) if (image || links) && (close = closing_bracket(text, opening)) label = text[(opening + 1)...close] if (dest = destination(text, close + 1, label)) reference, finish = dest url, title = reference attribute = title.nil? ? '' : %( title="#{escape_html(title)}") content = inline(label, links: false, notes: false) pieces << if image %() else %(#{content}) end at = finish next end end end if '*_~'.include?(char) finish = run_end(text, at) length = finish - at before = at.zero? ? ' ' : text[at - 1] after = text[finish] || ' ' can_open, can_close = !WHITESPACE.include?(after), !WHITESPACE.include?(before) can_open = can_close = false if char == '_' && /[A-Za-z0-9]/.match?(before) && /[A-Za-z0-9]/.match?(after) pieces << if (char != '~' && length <= 3) || (char == '~' && length == 2) Delimiter.new(char, length, can_open, can_close) else char * length end at = finish else pieces << escape_html(char) at += 1 end end emphasis(pieces) end def destination(text, at, label) if text[at] == '[' close = text.index(']', at + 1) if close && !text[(at + 1)...close].include?('[') name = text[(at + 1)...close] reference = @references[normalize(name.empty? ? label : name)] return reference ? [reference, close + 1] : nil end elsif text[at] == '(' url, finish = escaped_read(text, skip_space(text, at + 1), " \n)") position = skip_space(text, finish) title = nil valid = true if position > finish && position < text.size && "\"'".include?(text[position]) title, finish = escaped_read(text, position + 1, text[position]) valid = finish < text.size position = skip_space(text, finish + 1) if valid end return [[url, title], position + 1] if valid && text[position] == ')' end reference = @references[normalize(label)] reference && [reference, at] end def document(blocks) html = render_blocks(blocks) contents = table_of_contents html = html.gsub(TOC_MARKER) { contents } html << footnote_list unless @note_numbers.empty? html end def render_blocks(blocks) = blocks.map { |block| render(block) + "\n" }.join def render(block) case block.kind when :heading then heading(block.number, block.text) when :paragraph then "

#{inline(block.text)}

" when :rule then '
' when :code attribute = block.text.empty? ? '' : %( class="language-#{escape_html(block.text)}") "
#{block.lines.map { |line| escape_html(line) + "\n" }.join}
" when :quote then "
\n#{render_blocks(block.children)}
" when :alert %(
\n

#{block.text.capitalize}

\n#{render_blocks(block.children)}
) when :list tag = block.ordered ? 'ol' : 'ul' attribute = block.ordered && block.number != 1 ? %( start="#{block.number}") : '' "<#{tag}#{attribute}>\n#{block.items.map { |item| render_item(item) + "\n" }.join}" when :table html = "\n\n\n#{table_cells('th', block, block.lines)}\n\n" unless block.rows.empty? html << "\n" block.rows.each { |row| html << "\n#{table_cells('td', block, row)}\n" } html << "\n" end html << '
' when :toc then TOC_MARKER end end def heading(level, text) start = text.rindex(' {#') candidate = start && text.end_with?('}') ? text[(start + 3)...-1] : nil if candidate && /\A[A-Za-z0-9_-]+\z/.match?(candidate) id = candidate text = text[...start].sub(/ +\z/, '') else base = text.downcase.gsub(/[^a-z0-9_ \n-]/, '').tr(" \n", '--') base = 'heading' if base.empty? id = base suffix = 1 while @used_ids.key?(id) id = "#{base}-#{suffix}" suffix += 1 end end @used_ids[id] = true html = inline(text) @headings << TocEntry.new(level, id, strip_tags(html), []) %(#{html}) end def render_item(blocks) html = +'
  • ' blocks.each_with_index do |block, index| if block.kind == :paragraph text = block.text if index.zero? && text.size > 4 && ['[ ] ', '[x] ', '[X] '].include?(text[0, 4]) checked = text[1] == ' ' ? '' : ' checked=""' html << %( ) text = text[4..] end html << inline(text) else html << "\n" unless html.end_with?("\n") html << render(block) << "\n" end end html << '
    • ' end def table_cells(tag, table, cells) cells.zip(table.alignments).map do |cell, alignment| style = alignment ? %( style="text-align:#{alignment}") : '' "<#{tag}#{style}>#{inline(cell)}\n" end.join end def toc_list(entries) html = +"
      \n" entries.each do |entry| html << %(
    • #{entry.label}) html << "\n#{toc_list(entry.children)}\n" unless entry.children.empty? html << "
      • \n" end html << '
    ' end def table_of_contents return "
    \n
    " if @headings.empty? roots = [] parents = [] @headings.each do |entry| parents.pop while !parents.empty? && parents.last.level >= entry.level (parents.empty? ? roots : parents.last.children) << entry parents << entry end %(
    \n#{toc_list(roots)}\n
    ) end def reference_id(number, count) = "fnref-#{number}#{count == 1 ? '' : "-#{count}"}" def footnote_reference(name) @note_numbers[name] ||= @note_numbers.size + 1 number = @note_numbers.fetch(name) @note_counts[name] += 1 %(#{number}) end def footnote_list html = +"
    \n
      \n" @note_numbers.each do |name, number| body = inline(@footnotes.fetch(name), notes: false) backlinks = (1..@note_counts[name]).map { |count| %(↩) }.join(' ') html << %(
    1. #{body} #{backlinks}
      2. \n) end html << "
    \n
    \n" end end lines = [] STDIN.each_line do |line| line = line.chomp break if line == '@@END@@' lines << line end parser = BlockParser.new blocks = parser.parse(lines) print Renderer.new(parser.references, parser.footnotes).document(blocks)
